name: breadcrumb
description: Navigation trail showing the user's location within a hierarchy.

icon._rule: Paired icon — tracks the label's foreground per state (currentColor), never a fixed color/icon/*.

composition.assemblyRule: Items and separators alternate; separator never appears at start or end.

accessibility.keyboard: Tab stops on non-current links only.
accessibility.touchTarget: Items are visually below 44px; implementation needs min-height 44px wrapper.

constraints: Use breadcrumb only for 2+ hierarchy levels.
Icon=True is typically first item only.
Do not build a fixed composite breadcrumb component.

useCases: A settings page at 'Settings / Notifications / Email' shows the full path so users can step back to any level
An e-commerce PDP shows 'Home / Women / Shoes / Running' above the product title
A file manager displays the folder path 'Drive / Projects / 2026 / Q1' above the file list
A docs site shows 'Docs / Components / Breadcrumb' at the top of each article page
A support portal shows 'Help Centre / Billing / Refunds' so users know how they arrived at the article
A long hierarchy trail collapses middle items with an ellipsis to avoid wrapping on narrow viewports

Current=False.whenToUse: Navigable ancestor links in the trail
examples: Settings — any level the user can click back to

Current=True.whenToUse: The active page — non-interactive, always the last item

Icon=True.whenToUse: First item only, to provide a home/root visual anchor
examples: Home icon on the first crumb in a root-level trail

Separator Type=Chevron.whenToUse: Default — clear directional separator for most contexts
examples: Standard product, docs, and settings breadcrumbs

Separator Type=Slash.whenToUse: Lighter, more typographic feel — file paths and dev tools

Separator Type=Dot.whenToUse: Compact inline trails where space is very tight
examples: Narrow widgets only — avoid in standard navigation contexts

comparedTo.situation: Shows user's current location in a page hierarchy
Navigates between numbered pages of a dataset
Site-level navigation to different top-level routes
Switches between content sections on the same page

notes: Source markdown has no open questions.

Figma-only variable `breadcrumb/breadcrum` (Components collection) aliases spacing/component/xs (4px) — INTENTIONAL and NOT exported to JSON/CSS. It exists purely as a designer-facing reference so designers in Figma can see the item↔separator gap (4px) without reading the CSS. Do not flag as token drift; in code the gap is the semantic spacing/component/xs alias.

changelog.change: Leading icon now follows the system Paired icon rule — tracks the label's foreground per state (currentColor) instead of a fixed color/icon/default. Rebound icon strokes on all 8 Icon=True variants to match the label token (text/secondary, background/default/foreground, or text/disabled per Current × State). Disabled already matched. Verified in Figma.

darkMode.notes: No known dark mode differences — all tokens are semantic and mode-aware.
